chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Regarding the slave who has a free woman under him (as a wife), he said: His children are free. So if the slave is emancipated, he attaches to his father.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of children born to a slave father and a free mother in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of 'liberty follows the mother' (hurriyyatun li-l-um), ensuring children of a slave father and free mother are born free. It further establishes that upon the father's manumission, he retains his paternal bond and authority over his children, preventing separation, which underscores the stability of the family unit in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding the slave who happens to have the free woman under him (as a wife). He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His children would be free. So if the slave is emancipated, it would be attached with its father’.
